newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds trade lower with Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds trade lower with Treasuries.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities tallied losses across the board Wednesday, but spreads narrowed modestly, market players said.
Sellers handed discount coupons the greatest losses, while demand for higher-yielding issues was better, traders said.
In late trading, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5-percent paper was off 7/32 at 99-10/32, yielding 104 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac issues were off 8/32 at 99-11/32 and 99-16/32, respectively.
The 10-year note was off 12/32 at 6.71 percent.
